messages.subject: Fwd: Last chance to participate: 5th Annual Data Miner Survey
messages.subject_clean: Last chance to participate: 5th Annual Data Miner Survey
messages.body_plain:
For those interested, here is the annual survey of data mining.

Regards,
Graham

---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Karl Rexer <datamin...@rexeranalytics.com>
Date: 26 May 2011 04:26
Subject: [SPAM] Last chance to participate: 5th Annual Data Miner Survey
To: datamin...@rexeranalytics.com

The 2011 Data Miner Survey will close in early June.  Please participate now.  It will take about 20 minutes to complete the survey.

     Survey Link:  www.RexerAnalytics.com/Data-Miner-Survey-2011-Intro2.html <http://www.rexeranalytics.com/Data-Miner-Survey-2011-Intro2.html>
     Access Code:  RL3X2

If you have already participated, thank you.

Please also tell other data miners about the survey.  Forward this email.  They can use the same access code.

The survey is conducted annually by Rexer Analytics <http://www.rexeranalytics.com/>.  All analytic professionals are invited to participate.  Everyone’s responses are completely confidential.  All reporting of the survey findings will be done in the aggregate, and no findings will be written in such a way as to identify any of the participants.

A summary report of the survey results will be freely available to everyone.  If you want to be sent the summary report, there will be a place at the end of the survey to leave your email address.  Questions about this research and requests for last year's 37-page summary report can be directed to DataMin...@RexerAnalytics.com <http://us.mc5.mail.yahoo.com/mc/compose?to=Dat...@RexerAnalytics.com>.  Highlights of the 2010 survey results can be viewed at http://www.rexeranalytics.com/Data-Miner-Survey-Results-2010.html.

Thank you
-- Karl Rexer, PhD

======================
Karl Rexer, PhD
President, Rexer Analytics
www.RexerAnalytics.com <http://www.rexeranalytics.com/>
617-233-8185

messages.subject: Error message for Installation
messages.body_plain:
Hi.

When I install RATTLE following installation guide, I fail to install.

  - window XP

1. gtk2-runtime-2.22.0-2010-10-21-ash.exe <http://downloads.sourceforge.net/gtk-win/gtk2-runtime-2.22.0-2010-10-21-ash.exe>  download and install
2. R-2.13.0-win.exe <http://cran.r-project.org/bin/windows/base/R-2.13.0-win.exe>  download and install
3. Run R
4. install.packages("rattle")
5. > library(rattle)
6. > rattle()
The package 'RGtk2' is required to display the Rattle GUI. It does not appear to be installed. A package can be
installed with the following R command:
install.packages('RGtk2')
This will allow access to use the full functionality of Rattle.
7. Would you like the package to be installed now? (yes/NO) y
 :  rattle() :
  The RGtk2 package is not available but is required for the Rattle GUI.
=> Error message.

Where do I RGtk Package download ?

Pls let me know what diifference gti2-rubtime-2.22.0-2010-10-21.ash.exe and RGtk2 ?

Thanks.

--
JeongSeon, Lee

messages.subject: Re: Error message for Installation
messages.body_plain:
RGtk2 is the R package to interface the gtk library. It needs to be
installed from the CRAN repository. Are you conencted to the Internet
when you first attempt to run Rattle?

Regards,
Graham
